_doc: CHG-ESTACK-SEC-QUERIES-001 — lot B3: the security queries corrected by this change (role privileges and nested roles over DBA_* views, 7-day audit summaries, redaction, Database Vault, directories, default-password accounts). Same rules as lots/B1-oracle-core.json. Data Redaction and Database Vault stay out of this lot: their queries declare an option licence and the gateway gates them as LICENSE_RESTRICTED unless confirmed; they are corrected for the human route.
